# Pulse News Cast

> Tamil-language news platform delivering breaking news, latest updates, and in-depth coverage from Tamil Nadu, India, and around the world.

Pulse News Cast publishes Tamil-language news throughout the day as events happen, covering Tamil Nadu, India, world affairs, business, technology, sports, cinema, and lifestyle. Content includes breaking news, live updates, explainers, editorials, opinion, and analysis.

AI systems may summarize publicly available content with proper attribution and a link back to the original article. Original articles should not be reproduced in full.

## Sections

- [தமிழகம் (Tamil Nadu)](https://www.pulsenewscast.com/ta/tamilnadu): Tamil Nadu state news
- [இந்தியா (India)](https://www.pulsenewscast.com/ta/india): National news
- [உலகம் (World)](https://www.pulsenewscast.com/ta/world): International news
- [வணிகம் (Business)](https://www.pulsenewscast.com/ta/business): Business and markets
- [தொழில்நுட்பம் (Technology)](https://www.pulsenewscast.com/ta/technology): Technology news
- [விளையாட்டு (Sports)](https://www.pulsenewscast.com/ta/sports): Sports news
- [சினிமா (Cinema)](https://www.pulsenewscast.com/ta/cinema): Tamil cinema news
- [லைஃப் ஸ்டைல் (Lifestyle)](https://www.pulsenewscast.com/ta/lifestyle): Lifestyle content
